description: Search for files in Google Drive. Returns file names, IDs, types, and modification dates.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

page_size.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20)

query.description: Search query (Drive query syntax, e.g., "name contains 'report'" or "mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet'")

name: gws-mcp__drive_search
